tools.name: heart_fit
tools.description: Use this zero-AI preflight before heart_cast when the original question is ambiguous or unstructured. It rejects ordinary fact lookups, pure prophecy, fortune, hidden facts, traditional liuyao, and high-stakes professional replacement. It returns research_required, needs_detail, or out_of_scope, plus the autonomous agent's next step. A needs_detail response means the agent should extract or research objective, options, constraints, success criteria, and current evidence; it does not require a human reply when authorized sources are available.

question.description: The user's original question before six-position evidence mapping.

tools.name: heart_cast
tools.description: Deterministically cast a YOWAYOW Mind-Key hexagram from six evidence-grounded root/body/outcome positions. Use after an autonomous agent has researched a concrete action choice, structural diagnosis, experiment, or macro-structure question. Submit current facts and their manifestation verdicts; never submit yin/yang lines or a desired hexagram. The tool returns cast_ready, needs_evidence, or out_of_scope. It uses no LLM, no random/time casting, and never falls back to traditional liuyao. Do not use for fortune, luck, hidden facts, random outcomes, or as a substitute for high-stakes professional judgment.

purpose.description: Why the agent needs the cast. This MCP does not support fortune-telling or traditional liuyao.

options.description: Existing options. choose_action requires at least two distinct options.

time_horizon.description: Decision horizon, not a divination time seed. Example: next 90 days.

success_criteria.description: Observable criteria that would show the decision worked.

constraints.description: Known boundaries such as budget, regulation, capacity, deadlines, or risk limits.

evidence.description: Evidence for whether this position is currently manifested. Do not submit yin/yang or a desired hexagram.

verdict.description: manifested = currently active or observable; not_manifested = verified not yet active or observable; uncertain = not established.

tools.name: liuyao_cast
tools.description: Use when the user explicitly requests traditional Liuyao casting, Najia, six relatives/spirits or Shi/Ying. Do not send it through heart_fit. auto reuses the App's casting-time plus secure random perturbation algorithm with three-coin probabilities; manual preserves six existing 6/7/8/9 values ordered bottom to top. Supply the user's IANA timezone and the original casting time when replaying a plate. Returns original/changed hexagrams, all moving lines, calendar, Najia, six relatives/spirits, Shi/Ying, void and seasonal facts. It uses no LLM and does not generate a report or fixed interpretation. Preserve a successful result rather than rerolling to obtain a preferred hexagram.

question.description: Optional original question for the calling AI to interpret. It is not a Mind-Key evidence mapping.

method.description: auto uses the App engine: current or specified time plus fresh secure randomness, with three-coin-weighted 6/7/8/9 values. manual calculates a plate from an existing cast; never invent user-provided tosses.

datetime.description: Casting time, not a predicted event date. Omit to use the current instant. Without an offset it is a local civil clock in time_zone. Replay a manual plate with the original casting time.

time_zone.description: IANA timezone used for the casting calendar, e.g. Asia/Shanghai, America/New_York, Europe/London or Asia/Kuala_Lumpur. Supply the user's zone when known.

line_values.description: manual only: exactly six values ordered BOTTOM TO TOP, first toss / line 1 first. 6 = moving yin, 7 = static yang, 8 = static yin, 9 = moving yang. With 2/3-valued coins each value is the sum of three coins.
